findings.summary: history.py unlinks a cache file before refetching; an empty refetch (e.g. wrong date range) then loses the file for good.
findings.proposed_action: Write the refetched history to a temp file and rename on success instead of unlink-then-refetch; still open per next-steps.md §2.11.

findings.summary: cost_basis is blank on every row while both cost knobs are 0; split cost-model populations on cost_total/pct_stale_days non-blank instead.
findings.proposed_action: Add to lessons.md: never split on cost_basis for this reason; it silently reads as one uniform population.

findings.summary: File edits done via ad-hoc python heredoc substitution scripts instead of the Edit tool caused AssertionError retries and multi-round flake8 E127/E128 fixes in 2 sessions.
findings.proposed_action: Use the Edit tool for file edits; when flake8 fails, fix every reported line from one run rather than iterating error-by-error.

findings.summary: A study delta measured against DEBIT_PROD overstates production impact wherever a shipped regime cell already converts the same rows.
findings.proposed_action: already in research/lessons.md

findings.summary: A stale one-sided quote fed to the zero-bid mark fabricated a HYG credit read (entry -0.37 on a debit spread booked +100%).
findings.proposed_action: already in research/lessons.md (line 15, the silent-input-failure lesson); add this HYG 2025-04-09 instance as new evidence.

findings.summary: Three sessions edited files via ad hoc python3 heredoc string-replacement instead of the Edit tool, losing diff visibility.
findings.proposed_action: Prefer the Edit tool for straightforward text substitutions; reserve heredoc scripts for edits Edit cannot express.

findings.summary: Three parallel subagents building the same ladder_overlay contract each independently re-read the same doctrine files (writing-guide, arm-index, glossary).
findings.proposed_action: Have one subagent gather and pass along shared doctrine-file context before fanning out study-specific exploration.

findings.summary: A feature that separates outcomes may only be re-sorting structure or hold length; test within structure and at full coverage first.
findings.proposed_action: already in research/lessons.md

findings.summary: A gate keyed to a hand-transcribed snapshot constant fails once the cache grows; compare two live outputs instead of hardcoding one.
findings.proposed_action: already in research/lessons.md

findings.summary: A minimum-dates floor is not a density floor; a backfilled era can clear the date count with no consecutive sessions.
findings.proposed_action: already in research/lessons.md

findings.summary: A rollback census that barely clears its floor on a still-backfilling book is not a decision; read the census, not the absence of an alarm.
findings.proposed_action: already in research/lessons.md

findings.summary: A synthetic built on the engine's own signal dates re-wraps exposure already deployed; a positive correlation with the book means RE-WRAP, not a gain.
findings.proposed_action: already in research/lessons.md

findings.summary: A trailing stop gives back what a hard profit target locks in, because option spreads gap; it only pays in a sustained trend.
findings.proposed_action: already in research/lessons.md

findings.summary: Any input change is a new analysis version; rename live tabs vN_ in place and never pool across versions.
findings.proposed_action: already in research/lessons.md

findings.summary: Fix the verdict grammar before a run, never after a number; an unnamed outcome is assigned at build time with a printed qualification.
findings.proposed_action: already in research/lessons.md

findings.summary: One correlated window can carry a whole effect; re-cut every headline without it before believing the finding.
findings.proposed_action: already in research/lessons.md

findings.summary: Lesson-15's 'archive/01 §Attempt 1' pointer is about reactive exits misreading noise, not a confound; §'confidence, not regime' fits the claim.
findings.proposed_action: Swap for archive/01 §'What actually drives losses — confidence level, not regime' in lessons.md line 23.

findings.summary: Lesson-7's 'archive/06 §addendum 7' pointer only back-references addendum 6's silent-fallback finding; it is not its own instance.
findings.proposed_action: Drop the addendum-7 pointer from lessons.md line 15; addendum 6 (already cited) is the actual instance.

findings.summary: Production's zero-bid re-mark (3e5c2dc) has no mirror in bear_rewrap's reconstruction, so post-fold zero-bid rows now fail R2 and block hedge_structure.
findings.proposed_action: Mirror _zero_bid_mark in bear_rewrap.reconstructs, or re-price the affected retried dates without B5, per the operator decision flagged in next-steps.md §2.11.

findings.summary: ladder_overlay's gap/run cells correlate +0.16 to +0.38 with the deployed book, the same re-wrap pattern financed_spread printed.
findings.proposed_action: already in research/lessons.md (line 22, the re-wrap lesson); add ladder_overlay 2026-09-16 as a new instance.

findings.summary: Lesson-13's 'archive/11 §be_after grid RUN item 5' heading is a hypothetical unbuilt ratchet proposal, not the settled no-better-stop finding.
findings.proposed_action: Anchor lessons.md line 21 to item 2's 'every CI includes zero' (archive/11:236), the unconditional evidence, rather than item 5's hypothetical.

findings.summary: rtk find rejects compound predicates (-o/-not/-exec); two sessions independently hit this and had to fall back to plain find.
findings.proposed_action: Document that rtk find does not support -o/-not/-exec so agents use plain find for compound predicates.

findings.summary: Background watchers for a long scrape were killed by the low-memory guard 3x in one session before the agent switched to manual polling.
findings.proposed_action: Poll long-running scrape progress with short manual status checks instead of arming long-lived background Monitor/wait loops that the low-memory guard kills.

findings.summary: Lesson-1's 'archive/19 §2026-09-04 (late)' pointer is a 180-line undifferentiated re-run recap; current.md §Where the 2026 column bit states the measured-cost claim precisely.
findings.proposed_action: Swap that pointer for current.md#where-the-2026-column-bit (or the archive/19 be_after census lines) in lessons.md line 9.

findings.summary: Live walk-forward Stage 1/2 gate numbers (55 mapped/20 dates, 22 closes vs a 30-50 Stage-2 floor, 0 tier-A closes) agree between current.md and next-steps.md.
findings.proposed_action: none: both files already read consistently; no fold needed beyond the existing cross-links.

findings.summary: scripts/analyze_bt_queue.sh, whose own header says THROWAWAY/deliberately uncommitted, was committed to main via a blanket 'commit the rest'.
findings.proposed_action: Delete scripts/analyze_bt_queue.sh or fold it into scrape_and_enrich.sh as its header instructs, rather than leave it committed against its own stated intent.

findings.summary: TF-S was missing from core.py's play-pattern allowlist though present in the framework doc, wasting a retry; pattern codes have no single source of truth across code/docs/tests.
findings.proposed_action: Add an invariant, like ladder_tier's single-encoding rule, requiring scripts/analysis_pipeline/core.py's pattern allowlist to be updated in the same commit as config/prompts/analysis-framework.md.

findings.summary: Building ladder_overlay.py mixed python-heredoc patches (5x) and Edit calls (4x) on the same file plus a late flake8 E128 fix, adding churn to the 34-min build.
findings.proposed_action: Prefer the Edit tool over ad-hoc python heredoc rewrites for source patches, and run flake8 before the first full study run to catch formatting early.

findings.summary: dream adopt copies each proposed file over the live one unconditionally, with no check that the proposal is still current relative to the committed file.
findings.proposed_action: Add a staleness check to the dream adopt workflow that diffs each proposed file against the current committed version and warns when the live file moved since the proposal was generated.

findings.summary: ladder_overlay's v4 run write-up and queue-close were left undone; a later session had to reconcile four stale references before answering a simple question.
findings.proposed_action: Finish the current.md write-up and next-steps queue-close in the same session a study run completes, not in a later session.

findings.summary: A new tranche pricing engine (overlay_campaign) initially omitted credit_received from the mark series; caught only after the study module was built, before any run shipped.
findings.proposed_action: Add a test asserting credit_received appears in a new multi-tranche pricing engine's mark series before its first study run.

findings.summary: Before committing dream artifacts, account IDs/NetLiq leakage was checked only by an ad-hoc manual grep, not an automated pre-commit or adopt scan.
findings.proposed_action: Add an automated grep for account-id and NetLiq-style patterns to the dream commit/adopt step, running the same check this session did by hand every time.

findings.summary: No single checklist doc for registering a new study's doc/catalog entries; agent spent most of its calls reverse-engineering formats across 5 files.
findings.proposed_action: Add a short checklist to docs/architecture.md listing every file a new study must update (catalog.py, arm-index.md, glossary.md, study-map.md, next-steps.md) and their entry format.

findings.summary: trailing_stop_trigger is dead code whenever profit_target sits below it: the target fires first.
findings.proposed_action: already in research/lessons.md

findings.summary: Chained `sleep 90; <cmd>` was blocked by the Bash tool's own no-chained-sleep rule; agent had to redo the check without it.
findings.proposed_action: Never chain a sleep with a following command in one Bash call; use a bare status check or Monitor's until-loop instead.

findings.summary: Explore subagent re-read financed_spread.py and archive/16-first-runs-on-v3.md three times each within one session.
findings.proposed_action: Cache file contents already read once in a session instead of re-reading the same unchanged file.

findings.summary: A CRWV short put is labelled (overlay) by structure but matched SUBSTITUTED by the journal; the two vocabularies disagree on the same fill.
findings.proposed_action: Reconcile the structure-derived overlay label with the SUBSTITUTED match category so one leg is not described both ways.

findings.summary: general-purpose subagent ran the same python3 heredoc edit on overlay_campaign.py three times, fixing its own mistakes.
findings.proposed_action: Verify a heredoc edit script's target string against the file before running it, to avoid repeated fix-up passes.

findings.summary: CLAUDE.md says option_history_cache/ is ~337MB; exploration found 43,521 files totaling 629MB, the figure is stale.
findings.proposed_action: Update the option_history_cache size figure in CLAUDE.md's backtests-tier notes or drop the number and describe it qualitatively.

findings.summary: Explore subagent (haiku) re-read lib/barchart/session.py 4x and config/backtest.yml 3x in one session, redundant reads with no new info gained.
findings.proposed_action: When a Read call already returned a file's full content, reuse it instead of re-reading the same file again later in the same session.

findings.summary: Coordinator split lessons.md's 15 lessons into 3 subagent batches but mislabeled the ranges (lesson 6 dropped, re-appended), needing a manual remap mid-run.
findings.proposed_action: When fanning out a numbered list to N parallel subagents, print each subagent's exact item range before dispatch and verify the ranges partition the full list with no gaps or overlaps.

findings.summary: Hardcoded date tables (mech_regime_recut, regime_gap_reread) go PARTLY stale as the book grows, the same failure class as a hardcoded gate constant.
findings.proposed_action: already in research/lessons.md (line 16); generalize the wording to cover a hardcoded date list, not only a snapshot gate constant.

findings.summary: Plan subagent's chained bash one-liners with a bare `echo ===` separator hit a zsh '(eval):1: == not found' error twice in one session.
findings.proposed_action: Quote separator text (e.g. echo '===') instead of bare === when chaining shell commands with semicolons.

findings.summary: current.md's 'What was pruned from this log' section (in a 432-line file) duplicates archive/README.md's volume table and grows every prune cycle uncapped.
findings.proposed_action: Trim the pruned-log section to a single pointer per volume once README.md's table already names the same date range and topic.

findings.summary: Explore subagent told .codegraph/ and codegraph_explore were available instead ran ~22 manual find/grep/read calls, against the repo's CodeGraph-first rule.
findings.proposed_action: When delegating an explore task in a CodeGraph-indexed repo, tell the subagent explicitly to call codegraph_explore before grep/find.

findings.summary: backtests/study_output/ladder_overlay-v4-latest-20260910.txt vanished/renamed; a later investigation had to rediscover it as ladder_overlay-latest.txt.
findings.proposed_action: Keep era-dated study-output snapshot filenames stable once referenced elsewhere, or note the rename in the study's record.

findings.summary: AskUserQuestion used the undefined jargon 'working-state CSVs'; the user rejected it and asked 'what is this state', costing a clarification round.
findings.proposed_action: Name things concretely in AskUserQuestion prompts (e.g. 'run-history CSVs') instead of abstract nouns like 'state' to avoid a clarification round.

findings.summary: mech_cell NO_DATA on the newest date (Yahoo close not yet posted) isn't documented as self-healing via nightly backfill, so it can re-trigger the same question.
findings.proposed_action: Document in docs/architecture.md that mech_cell NO_DATA on the most recent date means the upstream close hadn't posted yet, and that the nightly backfill fills it automatically.
